data.title: Melrose Golf Villas
data.about:
Welcome ot Melrose Estate in Damac Hills. Offering an eclectic collection of villas with beautiful views of the golf course, this is the perfect place to find a home if you want the luxury lifestyle.

Home to not just the 18-hole championship golf course, but also the Malibu Bay beach, The Park and vast rolling greenery everywhere, Melrose Estates is also located ideally within Damac Hills.

location_tile.title: Located in Damac Hills, Melrose Estates residents will have easy access to major landmarks in the city.
location_tile.description:
The community is nestled close to Remraam, Arabian Ranches, Mudon, Dubai Sports City, and lies between Al Qudra Road and Hessa Street.

  • 06 mins – Mudon
  • 11 mins – Dubai Motor City | Dubai Sports City | Arabian Ranches | Remraam
  • 21 mins – Dubai Marina |Dubai Media City | Mall of Emirates
  • 23 mins – Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 28 mins – Downtown Dubai | Burj Khalifa | Dubai Mall
  • 31 mins – Dubai International Airport
